exposure: Gestational age at birth (23-25 weeks, 26-28 weeks, ≥29 weeks)
outcome: Hemodynamically significant patent ductus arteriosus (HsPDA) requiring treatment
cohort: Preterm/very low birth weight (PT/VLBW) infants (676 singletons and 299 multiples) born between 2008 and 2012 at a tertiary perinatal center in Singapore
finding: Neonatal mortality and morbidity were comparable between preterm/very low birth weight singletons and multiples overall, though preterm multiples born at ≤25 weeks gestation had a higher incidence of neonatal morbidity.
